'''Rylan Stallos''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Rylan tasked an Imperial-aligned individual to poison the hives in order to prevent the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] from infesting House Thul and attacking the other houses.
